_why: League tables whose points are NOT 3 x won + draw for a known, sourced reason (a forfeit without points, a points deduction). tests/test_warehouse.py check 38 accepts exactly these differences and still fails on any other, so a feed that changes shape is still caught. Keyed by competition (as standings.json names it) and the club's name in standings.json. `diff` = pts - (3*won + draw), constant for the rest of the season unless an appeal changes the ruling - when it does, update or delete the entry. Added 2026-11-08 (Tests red since 2026-11-07: the Botola ruling of 2026-11-06).

notes.why: Round 1 derby (2026-09-26, 1-3 on the pitch): the LNFP disciplinary committee ruled Wydad Temara lost 3-0 for fielding the suspended Imad Babassa, but Wydad AC does NOT receive the three points. 365scores counts the forfeit in Wydad's won column (4) while its points stay 11 = 3 real wins + 2 draws. Wydad AC has announced an appeal.
Same ruling: the derby is a 3-0 forfeit loss AND one more point is deducted (four points in all against the pitch result). 2 wins = 6, minus 1 = 5. Wydad Temara has announced an appeal.
